speakers.name: Dr. Simon Hung
speakers.title: ORTV & IAA Chairman
speakers.bio: Elder Simon Hung entered Overseas Radio & Television, Inc. (ORTV) as a young man and dedicated decades there, pioneering gospel films, music, and media ministry — earning recognition as a trailblazer in Chinese evangelical arts and media missions along the way. After stepping down as Executive Director of ORTV in 2019, he has continued to champion gospel media development and currently serves as Chairman of the Christian Tribune.

speakers.name: Dr. Cary Summers
speakers.title: President Emeritus of the Museum of the Bible
speakers.bio: Cary Summers is President Emeritus of the Museum of the Bible and founder and CEO of Nehemiah Group. He currently serves as Global Co-President of The Grace and Mercy Foundation.

speakers.name: Rev. Ryan Nunez
speakers.title: Palm Valley Church
speakers.bio: Senior Pastor of Palm Valley Church (PVC) in Arizona, one of the fastest-growing and largest churches in the West Valley of Phoenix, with multiple campuses including Goodyear and Buckeye. Known for a practical, life-applicable teaching style, he excels at translating deep biblical truth into everyday guidance that people can understand and apply. His goal is to help people encounter God in real life and find the motivation to move forward through life's challenges.

speakers.name: Rev. Kang Hee Ahn
speakers.title: Founder of Global Assistance Partner(globalassistancepartners.org), Founder and President of Covering All Nations(coveringallnations.com)

speakers.name: Rev. John Heston
speakers.title: First Baptist Church Tempe
speakers.bio: Dr. John Heston serves as FBC's Senior Pastor. He is a seasoned Pastor with over 25 years of experience in church leadership. He is committed to shepherding individuals to Christ, engaging the community in local and global outreach and has a strong focus on discipleship. Pastor Heston began serving at FBC on May 6, 2024 along with his wife Stacy and their 4 children, Ethan, Olivia, Lucas and Wesley.

speakers.name: Dr. Timothy Cheng
speakers.title: IAA International Executive Director
speakers.bio: Currently serving as CEO of Christian Tribune and Executive Director of Impact Asia Center, Dr. Cheng leads media and church renewal through innovative and transformative thinking. He guided the former through its digital transformation, expanding news, commentary, and lifestyle content into a vital public platform for the Chinese church. At Impact Asia Center, he actively builds cross-national church exchanges and cooperation networks, spreading faith values across Asia with far-reaching influence.

speakers.name: Rev. Mike Constantz
speakers.title: Saddleback Church
speakers.bio: Pastor of Global Missions at Saddleback Church and one of Pastor Rick Warren's most trusted colleagues, overseeing the church's global missions and community development work. He is the chief architect and executive leader of the PEACE Plan — a movement that mobilizes ordinary people in ordinary places to do extraordinary things, uniting churches worldwide to address five global giants: poverty, disease, illiteracy, injustice, and spiritual emptiness. His expertise lies in training churches to partner with local governments and businesses in tri-sector collaboration, transforming missions from short-term visits into long-term, sustainable community transformation — a model that has influenced tens of thousands of churches globally.
